plain_eoa.description: A conventional externally owned account with a nonzero ETH balance and no code.

native_eth_account.description: The account holding the WETH and BAYC positions below. It has an EIP-7702 delegation designator, so this is a native balance claim, not a plain EOA fixture.

weth_balance.description: A 0.1 WETH balance held by the same account as BAYC token 100. WETH balanceOf uses mapping base slot 3.

bayc_token_100_owner.description: BAYC ownerOf(100) for the same holder. The older EnumerableMap implementation reads the entries array length, the token index mapping, and the selected entry value.

safe_authorization.description: Safe v1.4.1 authorization. The proof covers the singleton, one owner link, and the threshold.

tornado_recent_root.description: The latest root of the Tornado Cash Classic 0.1 ETH pool. The proof covers the packed current root index and the selected word of the fixed roots array.
